title.narrative: CM-Community Development Program Support Project Phase-II

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective is to improve delivery of priority basic services (in targeted communes, and extend the ongoing process of decentralization to new regions. The main beneficiaries will be the communes and communities supported during PNDP I (155) plus 167 non covered communes, in which 110 in the five new regions.

The objective of the Second Phase of the Community Development Program Support Project for Cameroon is to improve the delivery of specified basic social services in targeted communes, and extend the ongoing process in support to decentralization to new regions. There are three components to the project; the first component of the project is the local development support. This component helps to improve the socioeconomic conditions, increase the productivity of the natural resource base, and increase incomes of the population in the communes supported by the project. Achieving these goals requires putting in place various infrastructures and socioeconomic investments. This component will channel grants to communes to co-finance Communal Development plans (CDP) preparation activities or CDP-subprojects, as the case may be. The second component of the project is the decentralization support for communes. This component strengthens the institutional capacities in support to the decentralization process. It will also provide assistance for the implementation of capacity building activities for communes and other local stakeholders, such as local service providers, multidisciplinary teams of the sectoral ministries and technical service providers to enable them to assume an effective role as promoters of local development. Finally, the third component of the project is the coordination, management, monitoring and evaluation, and communication. This component facilitates: (a) administrative, technical, and financial management of the program; (b) coordination among all institutional partners to ensure efficient support to communes for local development; (c) effective contractual arrangements with communes, sectoral ministries, including acquisition of the equipment necessary for implementing the program; and (d) monitoring and evaluation of the performance and the financial, environmental, and social impacts of the program.
